name: DS Cluster D11: Corporate Events (Earnings, Dividends)
description: Tests: earnings outputs (eps_surprise_percent), dividends, barssince pattern, is_valid guard on sparse data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D11: Corporate Events
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === EARNINGS ===
earn = earnings()()
had_earnings = is_valid(earn.actual_eps)
bars_since_earn = barssince(had_earnings)
in_drift_window = bars_since_earn <= 60

# Earnings surprise (guarded with is_valid)
surprise_pct = where(is_valid(earn.eps_surprise_percent), earn.eps_surprise_percent)

# === DIVIDENDS ===
div = dividends(dividend_type=DividendType.CD)()
had_div = is_valid(div.cash_amount)
div_amount = ffill(div.cash_amount)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="EPS Surprise %", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Actual EPS", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="Earnings"
    )
)((earn.eps_surprise_percent, earn.actual_eps, had_earnings))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Cash Amount", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="Dividend"
    )
)((div.cash_amount, had_div))

histogram(
    title="Post-Earnings Returns (60d window)",
    category="Events",
    bins=30
)(where(in_drift_window, rets))
